depth_interpretation.limitation: Finite public witnesses in analyze mode. Findings at marked positions; not exhaustive false-positive rates or a universal level equivalence.

protocol.disk_cache: OS cache not flushed; one full warmup per tool excluded
protocol.phpstan_cache: new tmpDir per invocation; cache miss confirmed from verbose output
protocol.configuration_probe_cache: separate tmpDir, never the measured analyzer cache
protocol.sealed_inputs: selected sources, config, migrations, composer files, tool configs and bootstrap entrypoints; no private hashes exported
protocol.order: one excluded warmup round, then cyclic three-tool Latin-square rounds
